setupEn: {{pat}}, a young employee freshly assigned to his department, has to carry documents up to the executive floor. The one who always receives them is {{docFull}}, the beautiful secretary everyone in the company talks about.
story: 最初は「お預かりします」と書類を受け取るだけだった{{doc}}さん。
残業の夜が重なるたびに話が長くなり、資料室や出張先でふたりきりになることが増えていく。
「今日は、　まだ帰らなくていいですよね」――誰もいない役員フロアで、敬語が少しずつ崩れていく。
30日目、明かりの落ちたオフィスで、ふたりの関係が変わる。
storyEn: At first, {{doc}} just takes the documents with a polite "I'll hold on to these."
As the late nights pile up, the talks run longer, and they keep ending up alone in the archive room or on business trips.
"You don't have to go home yet tonight, do you?" On an empty executive floor, her formal tone slowly slips.
On Day 30, in an office with the lights turned down, everything changes.
